description: Installation of two static internally illuminated signs.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 01001(P01), 01010(P01), 01020(P01), 01021(P01), 01022(P01), 01023(P01) and 01024(P01) and Supplementary Planning Document [received 21/04/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 7 - The internal illumination levels of the advertisements hereby approved shall not exceed 150 cd/sqm from dusk till dawn without written approval from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The double sided advert panel hereby approved shall be static display and not a moving display and the lighting is to be as described in the specification. The proposed signage shall have no intermittent light sources, moving features, animations or exposed cold cathode tubing.

Condition : 9 - All vehicles associated with the installation shall only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions. No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.
